name: BRICS
excerpt: BRICS is an association of five major emerging economies: Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa.
notes: BRICS is an association of five major emerging economies: Brazil, Russia, India, China, and South Africa, known for their significant influence on regional and global affairs.
